title: Use of Force Narrative Outline
summary: Covers what reviewers look for under Graham and the AG policy.

steps.text: Call or reason for contact; what you knew beforehand
Specific words and actions showing a threat to you or others
Commands, warnings, time, distance, cover, additional resources used or why not feasible
Each type of force, in order, and why it was necessary and proportional
Medical aid offered or given; injuries

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
